about: Round-13 bass evaluation (scratchpad lab, 62 Deezer/iTunes 30-s previews; 2 per group stored here). segs = pseudo-Spotify segments computed from the preview like tests/lab/py/analyze.py ([start s, loudness_max dB, timbre[1] brightness]); low = measured low band < 120 Hz (4th-order Butterworth, dB, 10 per s, first frame at lowT0); share = Mirage's own preview measure (band < 150 Hz vs. all, dB, bass.js bassProfile).
